semantics.capacity_rule: When no interval-ready GENERATED nonmember exists, retain the omission and reduce capacity by one.
semantics.loao_objective: Remove one selected asset and deterministically resolve the remaining operational set.
semantics.named_omission_rule: BCHSV-USDT and PEPE-USDT must have actual interval-ready replacements; capacity reduction is not sufficient for named omissions.
semantics.readiness_rule: A row is ready when either an actual replacement or a deterministic capacity reduction is materialized.
semantics.replacement_rule: Use the highest-ranked interval-ready GENERATED nonmember when available.
semantics.zero_bar_rule: Generated zero-bar intervals are valid empty audit domains and do not block authorization.
